_doc: Onboard two-stage operating points (YOLOv8s seed 0 + MobileNetV3-Large verifier seed 0). Thresholds were chosen on validation data only (SafeMineAI-main/src/analysis/twostage_rule_a.py, deploy_resolution.py). Recall / FP-per-image are the host replay of this repo's onboard code on the 189-image test split (results/host_replay_twostage/), not device measurements. Pass to live_detect.py as --imgsz/--conf/--verifier/--protect/--tau.

survey_640.note: Recommended. Same input size the thresholds were selected at.

fast_512x288.note: 36% of the pixels; loses about 3 recall points on the square benchmark images. Re-selecting thresholds at this size does not recover recall (the 0.97 validation target is unreachable even at conf 0.005) and multiplies false alarms (recall 0.929, 1.54 FP/img, results/host_replay_twostage/seed0_512x288_reselected.json), so the 640-selected thresholds are kept.
